sources.title: How do banking licences affect FSCS protection? | FSCS

brands.evidence: Yes. If Monzo goes bust, the UK’s FSCS protects up to £120,000 per person in eligible cash deposits

client_claims.text: The FSCS protects up to £120,000 per person in eligible cash deposits held with Monzo Bank.
Monzo is a UK-authorised bank, so your deposits have the same protection as at a UK high-street bank.
client_claims.note: Monzo is UK authorised by the PRA and FSCS protected.

client_claims.text: In most cases, the FSCS pays you back automatically within seven working days; you don't need to make a claim.
client_claims.note: Payout timing not covered by facts.

client_claims.text: A two-person joint account can have up to £240,000 protected in total, with each person's share counting towards their own £120,000 limit.
client_claims.note: Joint account protection not covered by facts, though consistent with the £120,000 per person limit.

client_claims.text: Monzo current account, regular Pots, and savings held directly with Monzo all count towards the single £120,000 limit.
client_claims.note: Which products aggregate is not covered by facts.
